name: Egyházasrádóc (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and light grey at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egyházasrádóc: a crowned blue shield with a white church, with blue and grey mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Egyházasrádóc arms with crown and mantling
